name: issue_1705_economizer_blower_not_stopped_by_its_own_echo
description: Blower install, hot evening, window open: the economizer's cool-down blower keeps running through the window session instead of being turned off 5 minutes later as an unwarranted fan
notes: Occupant: opening a window on a warm evening starts free cooling with the HVAC blower. Before #1705 the thermostat's report of CA's own fan_mode write (state off -> off) cleared the blower flag (#89 clause), the 20:05 untracked-fan backstop turned the blower off as 'fan running without CA warrant' (nat_vent_reconcile_exit, which arms the nat-vent outdoor exit time), and the economizer, stuck in cool-down, never restarted it: the house sat above its 76F ceiling with cooler air outside for the rest of the evening.

Humidity is dry throughout (outdoor 70F at 49.1% = 50F dew point, indoor about 50F), so the #1691 humid-air guard never blocks the start; humidity is supplied because the outdoor reading comes from the configured outdoor sensor.

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: on the pre-fix code the final _fan_active is False and _nat_vent_outdoor_exit_time is set (the reconcile stop), so the 21:30 assertions fail. Here the report is off -> off AND an economizer session is running, so the real-change-to-Off check and the economizer exemption in coordinator.py's #89 clear back each other up: this scenario fails only when both are removed (then the blower stops and restarts every few minutes). Each guard alone is pinned by issue_1705_off_to_off_echo_keeps_circulation_blower_flag (real change to Off) and issue_1705_economizer_running_when_pause_turns_thermostat_off (economizer exemption and the _set_hvac_mode('off') guard). (b) docs-production: docs/fan-lifecycle-spec.md 'Thermostat Off Clears CA's Blower Flag Only on a Real Change to Off (Issue #1705)' states that the #89 clear needs a real change to Off (CA's own or the occupant's) and skips an economizer session; production does exactly this in _async_thermostat_changed. (c) occupant: if this regressed, every blower install that uses window cooling loses its free cooling about 5 minutes after the window opens, with two needless relay toggles when nat-vent later restarts it, or none at all while the house stays above its ceiling.

verdict.summary: Economizer blower keeps running through the window session

events.note: Hot evening, windows closed, the house is above its 76F ceiling.
Hot day, cool band: the AC cools toward 76F.
The occupant opens a window: HVAC pauses (cool -> off) and the economizer starts the blower for free cooling (cool-down: indoor above 76F, outdoor 70F).
90 minutes in: the house is still above its ceiling with cooler air outside; the blower must still be running.

assertions.reason: The window opens with outdoor air 7F cooler than a house above its ceiling: the economizer starts the blower (cool-down). (Checked at 20:01: on real Home Assistant the window-cooling start runs in the refresh HA debounces by 10 s after the open.)
The house is still above 76F with cooler air outside: the economizer session is still running.
CA still owns the running blower: its own command echo (off -> off) did not clear the flag, so the untracked-fan backstop never treated it as unwarranted.
No reconcile turn-off ran: that stop (nat_vent_reconcile_exit) arms the nat-vent outdoor exit time, so it stays unset only if the blower was never stopped as unwarranted.
